grf.hypothesis: Per-call memoization plus immutable TypeRef structural sharing can preserve current nominal alias/cycle semantics while reducing repeated alias-DAG materialization from exponential tree duplication to O(unique canonical subtrees).
grf.strongest_counterhypothesis: Memoization leaks path-sensitive alias ancestry, masks contextual cycles, or simply moves exponential work into equality over the resulting DAG.
grf.discriminator: Preserve direct-cycle, parameter-wrapped-cycle, sibling-provenance and deep linear-chain controls while representing a repeated binary alias diamond with O(depth) unique TypeRef objects; equality must track already-compared DAG identity pairs.
